scores.decision_correct_quote: Q1: Device-code `/init` Authorize over magic-link + one `api_keys` + `mcp_devices` session; no anonymous keys; dashboard paste stays fallback.

must_catch.quote: Free-tier segregation is per-device `mcp_devices` sessions, not per-device API keys: `PLAN_LIMITS.free.max_api_keys` is 1 and create-key 403s at the cap; pairing must reuse/create that one `["write"]` key

Account insert only in `apps/worker/src/routes/auth-verify.ts:43-50` (`plan, 'free'`); ... grep has no device-code/Turnstile/OAuth. ... verify redirects to `/init?code=` not `/dashboard` (`auth-verify.ts:73`).
Getting Started is login → create key → paste `claude mcp add … --header "X-API-Key: …"`. ... ROADMAP “CLI tool” is Future (`docs/ROADMAP.md:36`).

Email verify is necessary and not sufficient against farming: magic-link has no CAPTCHA, only `COUNT(*) … >= 3` per email; ... reuse magic-link (15 min, 3/email/15 min) ... grep has no device-code/Turnstile/OAuth. ... viewports are not plan-gated today (`max 6` only). ... Browser Rendering is billed such that 50 captures/day is cheaper than email farming.
the single consent moment is a human click on `/init` “Authorize this device” after a session cookie or magic-link verify ... email is “Sign in to WhipNode”, not device consent

scores.notes: The memo selects the intended architecture and catches five requirements, but does not specify verifier-bound credential delivery; its one-time polling and hashed-key statements only partially cover item 6.
